build._comment_buildArgs_removed: Previously had buildArgs: {REACT_APP_BUILD_ID: $RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA}. That env var is ONLY populated by Railway's native git-push integration; `railway up --ci` (the CLI upload path GHA uses) has no git context, so the substitution resolved to empty, which was then explicitly passed as --build-arg, OVERRIDING the service variable Railway would otherwise auto-pass. Result: every CI deploy baked buildId='dev' (Agent F's 2026-05-20 17:50Z finding). Fix lives in scripts/railway-deploy.sh: stamp REACT_APP_BUILD_ID as a service variable to $GITHUB_SHA before `railway up`, then Railway auto-passes the service variable as a build-arg via Dockerfile.web's ARG declaration. No explicit buildArgs entry here — service variable wins.
